answer: What keeps this honest is amateur radio callsign binding with QSL card hash, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 679 aliases would need 679 separate proofs, each costing about 101 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The wander sits in the mechanism itself, the raven sits in the price of faking it, and the marble sits in the record no template can forge. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
